_source: capability suite 2026-10-07/08 (evals/scorecard-20261008.md) and Godot suite 2026-10-14 (evals/scorecard-godot-20261014.md) on the reference machine: RTX 5070 Ti 16 GB + RTX 2060 6 GB, 64 GB RAM

worker.why: 19/20 agent runs passed (mean 0.99) across coding, UE Python/C++/render, Blender, ffmpeg, audio; median 2-7 min per task, 2-4x faster than Bonsai; peak context <= 87K of 131K

retry.why: equal quality (19/20, mean 0.99) but a different model: a retry shouldn't repeat the first attempt's blind spot

long_context.why: 3/3 recall at 24K/106K/188K, prefill ~900 tok/s; use for reading huge logs or files beyond ~100K tokens

log_triage_fast.why: 0.75 triage score in ~20 s on the small second GPU; first pass only, Claude confirms

vision_prescreen.why: exposure 0.97, defects 0.94; Bonsai misses borderline overexposure. Pre-screen only: Claude makes the call

harness.why: Claude Code worker: 19/20 per model; OpenCode with the same Bonsai: 7/10, slower, more context

gpu_policy.why: agent context needs 20-112K (too much for the 32K co-resident mode); Qwen3.6 reloads in ~4-5 s (warm page cache), plus re-reading the worker's context at ~430 tok/s

claude_only: brief, plan, shot design, final creative calls
visual QA verdicts (local vision is pre-screen only)
musical tempo/structure review (graders can't check tempo reliably)

worker.why: Godot suite 2026-10-14/15, 2 runs per task: 8/8 passed, ~31 min per 4 tasks (fastest, fewest turns/context): port 3->4, race logic 21/21, platformer + exports, Movie Maker clip

retry.why: also 8/8 (~91 min per 4 tasks, ~3x slower) and the best-looking clips by eye: retries and look-critical steps

not_recommended.qwen3.6-35b-a3b: 4/8 over 2 runs (rep 2: 3/4 after the tooling fixes): fails the platformer (autopilot timing + time limit)
not_recommended.mellum2.1-12b: 0/4: loses the task inside Claude Code's long system prompt (12B too small for this harness)
not_recommended.qwen3.8-27b-q3: 1/4: limited by the 49K context that fits in 16 GB (template fixed)
